messages.subject: Activity pattern overlap title errors
parts:
Hello, I wanted to copy/paste an exchange with Juergen from last week because I feel others may be having the same issue with Activity pattern titles (see below).

"Hello!

For some reason, the plot of an activity overlap I have entered continues to have errors in the title. Currently, the title says "subset_speciesA$Time.rad and subsetspeciesB$Time.rad." I have tried with several species and all titles end up looking like this. Any idea of what's causing this?
Thanks for your help!"

J-

"This is a change in the new version 1.0 of the package. In previous versions, the main title was fixed and could not be removed.
Now you can change or remove it by setting argument main. See the vignette for an example. Set main = "" to remove the title.

The issue is that main is passed to overlapPlot, which uses a different input (2 vectors of times instead of a data frame). So what shows up in the title is the names of those 2 time vectors, which are columns of your record table (hence "subset_speciesA$Time.rad and subsetspeciesB$Time.rad.")

I agree the implementation is not ideal. It might be better to create the old title by default if argument main is not set, and only change the title when main is specified. What do you think?"



Me: "Thank you for your assistance with this. Yes, I think having the default title in there with an option to change is the better way to go. That way you only have to change if you want to."

Also, I kept getting an error when trying to change the title as instructed. I'm not sure what's going wrong...Here's what it looks like:

activityOverlap(recordTable = EMdata2, speciesA = "lupus", speciesB = "latrans", speciesCol = "Species", recordDateTimeCol = "Photo.time", recordDateTimeFormat = "%H:%M:%S", plotR = TRUE, createDir = FALSE, pngMaxPix = 1000, add.rug = TRUE, main= paste("Activity overlap:", speciesA_for_Activity, "-", speciesB_for_activity))

 Error in paste("Activity overlap:", speciesA_for_Activity, "-", speciesB_for_activity) : 
  object 'speciesA_for_Activity' not found

Thanks again for your help!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Activity pattern overlap title errors
parts:
Hi Ryan,
thank you for posting this.

About the last error... the objects "speciesA_for_Activity" and "speciesB_for_activity" don't exist. You need to create them before running the function. Here is a reproducible example:

data(recordTableSample)

# define species of interest
speciesA_for_activity <- "VTA"    # = Viverra tangalunga, Malay Civet
speciesB_for_activity <- "PBE"    # = Prionailurus bengalensis, Leopard Cat

# create activity overlap plot
activityOverlap (recordTable = recordTableSample,
                 speciesA    = speciesA_for_activity,
                 speciesB    = speciesB_for_activity,
                 writePNG    = FALSE,
                 plotR       = TRUE,
                 add.rug     = TRUE,
                 main        = paste("Activity overlap: ", speciesA_for_activity, "-", speciesB_for_activity)
)

Cheers,
Jürgen
